directive.quote: Own Workshop main repair and shared tool packaging

old_copy.deleted_with: dc79bb0a87cd87abefba2c68360492c797546604 removed the original active path; the published-main reader confirms its absence.

preserve: WAV framing, loudness-based voice activity and bounded utterances are the original mechanisms.
Idle listening keeps no words or model history; wake, dismissal and session expiry remain the voice-session owner's decisions.
The loop mutes its own answer and the configured tail, and retains text when saying the answer fails.
allowed_deltas: Keep the existing Workshop DATA and voice-session imports.
Keep the already-supported injected hear/think/say/play boundary and granted folder; the historical platform-owned realParts, startCapture and long-lived tool entry are not ported by this core.
Move the existing adapted implementation behind an export-only compatibility entry after the separate exact source baseline was committed.
banned_substitutions: A second implementation in the compatibility entry.
Claiming that the earlier mixed adapter birth was an exact source-only baseline.
An idle transcript, self-answer loop, or fallback system voice.
